title: Cybersecurity Workstation
summary: Build Your Cybersecurity Learning Environment: a safe, isolated virtual lab you will use for the rest of the course.
objectives: Install a hypervisor and Linux VM
tasks: Record your computer's CPU, cores, RAM, free disk and virtualization support (VT-x/AMD-V)
Install a free hypervisor (VirtualBox or VMware Workstation Pro free edition)
Download a Linux ISO/VM image and verify its SHA-256 checksum
Create a VM (2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 40 GB disk where possible) and install Linux
Create an Internal/Host-only network and attach the VM to it
Take a snapshot named 'clean-install' and practise restoring it
Write a one-page setup document with a simple network diagram
List five personal lab safety rules
deliverable: Setup document (specs, hypervisor, VM settings, network mode, snapshot plan, diagram, safety rules).

rubric.excellent: All work in isolated lab or supplied data; scope and rules stated and followed.
rubric.insufficient: Any activity outside the lab, scope or rules (automatic fail).

rubric.excellent: Specs and settings recorded correctly with checksum evidence.
Clear diagram and notes others could follow.

Complete the Network Basics and Subnetting labs
Write firewall rules (in words) allowing only needed traffic between zones
deliverable: Network design pack: subnet table, diagram, addressing plan, test results, zone rules.

title: API Security Project
summary: Assess a mock API using supplied endpoints and data.
objectives: Find BOLA, excessive data and mass assignment
tasks: Review the supplied endpoint list: GET /api/v1/users/{id}, PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}, GET /api/v1/orders/{id}, POST /api/v1/coupons/redeem, GET /api/v0/users (legacy)
